title: 17. 엄마 손 꼭, 안심 폭!
titleT: 17. Hold Mom's Hand Tight, Feel Safe!

pages.ko: "손 꼭! 엄마 곁에!" 엄마랑 마트에 갈 땐 늘 이렇게 약속해요. 오늘도 호리는 엄마 손을 꼬옥 잡고 사부작사부작 걸어가요. 카트가 데굴데굴, 마트 안은 알록달록 신기한 게 참 많아요.
pages.t: "Hold hands tight! Stay by Mom!" That's the promise Hori always makes before going to the market with Mom. Today, too, Hori holds Mom's hand tight and walks along, step by step. The cart goes rolling, rolling, and the market is full of colorful, amazing things.

pages.ko: 그런데 저기 알록달록 풍선 코너가 반짝! 호리는 그만 손을 슬며시 놓고 후다닥 달려갔어요. "우와, 풍선이다!" 정신없이 구경하는 사이, 카트 소리가 점점 멀어져요.
pages.t: But look, over there — a sparkly, colorful balloon corner! Hori quietly let go of Mom's hand and dashed right over. "Wow, balloons!" While Hori was busy looking at them, the sound of the cart grew farther and farther away.

pages.ko: 실컷 구경하고 뒤를 돌아보니— 어라? 엄마가 없어요. 카트도 안 보여요. 낯선 사람들 다리 사이로 두리번두리번. 호리 가슴이 콩닥콩닥, 눈에 눈물이 그렁그렁 맺혀요.
pages.t: After looking around to his heart's content, Hori turned back — huh? Mom was gone. The cart was nowhere to be seen. Hori looked around and around between strangers' legs. Hori's heart went thump-thump, and tears welled up in his eyes.

pages.ko: 울먹이던 호리는 엄마 말이 딱 떠올랐어요. "길을 잃으면— 그 자리에 멈춰!" 그래서 호리는 뛰어다니지 않고 발을 멈췄어요. 후우, 크게 숨을 한 번 쉬었지요. "괜찮아, 나 할 수 있어."
pages.t: Just as Hori was about to cry, Mom's words popped into his head. "If you ever get lost — stop right where you are!" So Hori stopped running around and stood still. Whew, he took one big breath. "It's okay, I can do this."

pages.ko: 멈춰 서서 두리번거리니, 초록 앞치마를 두른 코끼리 직원 언니가 보였어요. 엄마가 그랬어요. "도와줄 어른, 마트 직원에게 말해!" 호리는 용기를 내어 뚜벅뚜벅 다가갔어요.
pages.t: Standing still and looking around, Hori spotted an elephant staff member wearing a green apron. Mom had said, "Tell a helpful grown-up — a market staff member!" Hori gathered his courage and walked right up to her, step by step.

pages.ko: "언니, 저… 엄마를 잃어버렸어요." 호리는 또박또박 말했어요. "우리 엄마 이름은 호랑 엄마예요!" 코끼리 언니가 무릎을 굽혀 눈을 맞췄어요. "잘했어! 여기서 언니랑 같이 찾자." 손 꼭! 엄마 곁에!
pages.t: "Excuse me... I lost my mom." Hori spoke clearly and slowly. "My mom's name is Mama Tiger!" The elephant staff member knelt down to meet Hori's eyes. "You did great! Let's look for her together, right here." Hold hands tight! Stay by Mom!

pages.ko: 코끼리 언니가 마이크에 대고 안내 방송을 했어요. "딩동댕— 호리 어린이가 엄마를 찾고 있어요!" 호리는 언니 곁에 꼭 붙어 서서 기다렸어요. 이제 하나도 무섭지 않아요. 조금만 기다리면 돼요.
pages.t: The elephant staff member made an announcement over the microphone. "Ding-dong-dang — Little Hori is looking for his mom!" Hori stood close beside her and waited. Now he wasn't scared at all. He just had to wait a little bit.

pages.ko: 그때 저 멀리서 카트를 밀며 엄마가 헐레벌떡 달려왔어요. "호리야!" "엄마—!" 호리는 쪼르르 달려가 엄마 품에 폭 안겼어요. 엄마가 호리를 꼭 껴안고 등을 토닥토닥.
pages.t: Just then, from far away, Mom came rushing over, pushing the cart. "Hori!" "Mom—!" Hori ran straight to her and dove right into her arms. Mom hugged Hori tight and patted his back, gently.

pages.ko: 엄마가 호리 손을 다시 꼬옥 잡았어요. "우리 호리, 멈춰서 직원 언니한테 말했구나. 정말 씩씩했어!" 코끼리 언니도 손을 흔들어 주었어요. 호리는 엄마 손을 놓치지 않으려 더 꼭 쥐었지요.
pages.t: Mom held Hori's hand tightly again. "My Hori, you stopped and told the staff member. You were so brave!" The elephant staff member waved too. Hori gripped Mom's hand even tighter so he wouldn't lose it again.

pages.ko: 이제 호리는 알아요. 길을 잃어도 멈추고, 직원 언니에게 말하고, 엄마 이름을 말하면 다시 만날 수 있다는 걸! "엄마, 나 이제 안 무서워!" 엄마랑 호리는 손을 흔들흔들 잡고 집으로 걸어가요. 손 꼭! 엄마 곁에!
pages.t: Now Hori knows. Even if you get lost, if you stop, tell a staff member, and say your mom's name, you can find each other again! "Mom, I'm not scared anymore!" Mom and Hori walk home together, hands swinging happily. Hold hands tight! Stay by Mom!

overview.ko: 시장에서 한눈팔다 엄마를 놓친 호리가 무서움을 이겨내고 '제자리에서 기다리기' 규칙으로 엄마를 다시 만나는 안전 동화입니다.
overview.t: A safety story about Hori, who gets distracted at the market and loses sight of Mom, but overcomes his fear and finds her again by following the 'stop and stay in place' rule.

lessons.t: If you get lost, stop and wait right where you are.

readingTips.ko: 외출 전에 함께 읽고 약속을 정해 주세요.
readingTips.t: Read this together before heading out and agree on a safety promise.

readingTips.ko: '엄마 손 꼭' 후렴으로 손잡기를 연습해 보세요.
readingTips.t: Practice holding hands using the 'Hold hands tight' refrain.
